connector.stress_interpretation: 0.05 ohm per mated power pole, two poles in series once =0.10 ohm. Explicit conservative interpretation, not an OEM qualified loop-resistance guarantee or measured value.

voltage_planes.pack_V: Protected pack-side differential voltage before the chosen mated-contact loop; already includes pack/BMS internal sag. Not OCV, cell voltage, or the downstream J200 voltage.
voltage_planes.junction_V: J200 project output pads after both shared contact poles, before F201/F202 branch split.
voltage_planes.main_fused_V: F201.2 / U201.2 / R215.1, after declared main pre-sense resistance, relative to INPUT_RETURN.
voltage_planes.main_input_V: U203.1 and U205 bias input, after remaining main branch resistance.
voltage_planes.aux_input_V: U202.1 after declared F202/wire resistance, relative to INPUT_RETURN.

cases.main_branch_definition: Explicitly excludes upstream MC35 contacts; includes fuse, Q201, shunts and main wire/PCB resistance as declared allocations. Does not inherit the ambiguous old path as a measured value.
cases.controller_input_scope: Declared input-side controller/divider allowance at MAIN_FUSED, distinct from the 0.25W post-precharge startup bias allocation; not a measured bound.

load_binding.standby_case: CHB and post-precharge startup bias OFF; input controller allowance and full allocated STOP load retained. Not a precharge trajectory.

thermal_binding.output_power_boundary: CHB and THN output allocation planes, not measured power delivered to motors; additional output distribution loss remains unbound.
